basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old graphic designer based in Portland, Oregon. I have a penchant for retro synthwave and ambient guitar tracks, which often fuel my creative sessions. Although I spend most of my weekdays working on freelance projects, I love unwinding with some online gaming or catching up on the latest sci-fi series. My weekends are usually reserved for exploring the local music scene or hiking. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to explore new interests and hobbies. I typically browse Reddit during late evenings, around 9 PM to midnight, while listening to my favorite playlists.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in music comes from years of self-teaching and playing in a local band during college. I have a decent understanding of digital art tools, gained through online courses and practical experience. I'm also an avid reader of science fiction and fantasy, which has broadened my vocabulary and creative thinking.
